msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. REGLA B: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia acouga-20c.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing brown leather western cowboy boots with stitching, worn with a long dark skirt and a cream jumper from the reference, walking at a quiet granite street in Salvaterra de Miño, Pontevedra, Spain, near the Miño river, with green trees, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia acouga-08.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of burgundy suede lace-up barefoot ankle boots with a thin flexible sole, no logos from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia acouga-07c.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of black leather chelsea barefoot ankle boots with elastic sides and a thin sole, no logos from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia acouga-27c.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): E-commerce product photo of taupe suede pointed ballet flats with a strap and small gold studs, no logos from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia acouga-20c.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of brown leather western cowboy boots with stitching, no logos from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail.
